purpose: Audit local route omissions and compare tighter thresholds without changing canonical exposure or donor roles
route_metric: Existing mean one-way scheduled generalized elapsed time, including initial waiting; winter 2026 held fixed
local_candidate_rule: Exact identity of municipal origin stop and at least one station access stop; evidence to review, not an approved exposure or zero-minute journey
local_audit_geography: Municipality containing the selected station bus/train stop, not necessarily the lift footprint or lodging basin
moutier_rule: Reuse approved analytical territory 6831; verify route equality with predecessor 700 before dropping duplicate route rows
